meta.based_on: BMPT-34 (obr. 1943) War Thunder CDK user mod by TunderTunder: T-34 chassis, open-topped turret with two 25 mm 72-K guns and a pair of heavy rockets
meta.notes: Imported one-to-one from the mod (tools/wt_import.py): the render model, skeleton and damage model out of bmpt34.grp, armour thickness and class per part, ammunition stowage, crew seats, engine, gearbox and weapon mounts out of bmpt34.blk. What a user mod takes from the game's own files (the 72-K's rounds and rate of fire, the rocket, the sight) is filled in from the 72-K's service figures; WT's textures are not part of the mod, so the model is painted in flat colours by material.
